settings.title: Why Your Neighbors Trust Petitt Heating & Cooling

settings.editor: Since 2010, the Petitt family has treated every Middle Tennessee home like our own. We aren't a big national chain. Instead, we are a local team that believes in transparency and doing the job right the first time.

icon_list.text: Licensed & Certified: We hold specialized gas and mechanical licenses, backed by over 800+ 5-star reviews from families just like yours.
Community Rooted: We live and work in the same Sumner, Davidson, and Robertson County neighborhoods we serve.
Professional Respect: We promise to leave your living room cleaner than we found it, using drop cloths and careful tools to protect your home

settings.title: Every New Installation is Backed by the Petitt Promise:

icon_list.text: The $500 Guarantee: We respect your time. If our team doesn’t show up on your scheduled installation day, we’ll pay you $500.
10-Year Parts & Labor Warranty: We protect your investment for a decade. If our installation fails, we’ll make it right at no cost to you.
12-Hour Emergency Response: Once you’re a Petitt customer, you’re family. If your system goes out, we’ll be there within 12 hours—no questions asked.

settings.editor: We’re known for being honest, respectful, and thorough, offering the best HVAC and plumbing services throughout Sumner County, Davidson County, and Robertson County. If you own a home or business, be sure to trust in us for it all.
